item: A keyword row in one language never takes another language's mention (R698)
summary: Keys are spelled language-agnostically, so English errors and Spanish errores shared one row and the Q414 vote labelled it Spanish. Extraction, the fold and the restore carry now file a mention under the term's row in its own language or one with no language, else create one; unknown-language articles keep the lowest id. The carry resolves with the same Python rule and re-indexes an article whose language the indexer would change. Old rows converge only after a re-index.
